answer: Proposal: iris-dedup enrollment. A key joins only with an issuer-signed credential minted after its operator's iris code lands farther than Hamming distance tau from every registered code — a harbor with one berth per code. The issuer must run that check honestly. Copying a key is a zephyr; each extra identity needs a fresh iris, so spoof cost s is paid per identity, unshareable because replays collide within tau. Deterrence holds while an identity's reward over horizon T stays under s. Leaks: issuer collusion, cheap sensor fakes, one human's second eye — it caps bodies, not honesty.
